form.title: New area request
form.description: Pick the area, enter checkouts and occupied rooms, and request pieces per item.
form.suggestEmpty: The area has no rooms with a kit to suggest from; enter quantities by hand.
form.suggestDone: Suggestion computed over {{rooms}} rooms. You can adjust the quantities.
form.noProducts: There are no linen items in the catalog.

requests.title: Area requests
requests.description: Linen requests from areas to the laundry: requested, delivered, received and pending.

detail.title: Request detail
detail.transfersHint: The floor attendant receives each transfer on the Transfers screen.
detail.cancelMessage: The request will be cancelled. Continue?
detail.confirmBlocked: There are transfers in transit not yet received.
detail.confirmMessage: You confirm with your signature that the area received what was delivered. Continue?

fulfill.title: Supply {{folio}}
fulfill.hint: Enter what you deliver now to {{area}}. An in-transit transfer is created that the floor attendant must receive.
fulfill.overPending: Some lines have more pieces than pending.
fulfill.cosign: Floor attendant co-signs (confirms with their password)

dirty.title: Dirty linen intake
dirty.description: Dirty linen delivered by areas per cart; the laundry counts and signs it.

form.title: New dirty linen intake
form.description: Count the cart per item. On save, the person delivering signs with their user and password.
form.noPrefill: The area had no deliveries that day; add items by hand.
form.splitMismatch: Good + stained + damaged must add up to dirty received ({{n}}).
form.shortageTotal: Total shortage: {{n}} pieces. Responsible people will be notified.

laundry.title: Laundry
laundry.description: Laundry linen by stage, with average wash cycles per piece.

move.title: Move {{name}}
move.nothing: This item has no pieces that can be moved to another stage.

firstWash.title: First wash
firstWash.hint: Moves new linen to the laundry for its first wash; it enters as dirty.

supplierReturn.action: Return to warehouse as factory defect
supplierReturn.title: Factory defect return
supplierReturn.hint: Sends pieces with factory defects back to the warehouse to return them to the supplier.

lines.cosign: Person delivering signs (another person confirms with their password)

reconciliation.title: Daily reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Per area: what was delivered to the floor versus dirty received and what is still in use.
reconciliation.empty: There are no dirty intakes that day.
